content: Yenibɑn biru, Asuresi u Hɑmɛdɑtɑn bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ Aɡɑɡin bweseru wɔlle suɑ. Mɑ u nùn kuɑ yiruse win bɑndu sɔɔ.
Sinɑ kpɑɑrun sɔm kowobu kpuro bɑ rɑ Hɑmɑni kpunɛwɑ, domi sinɑ bokowɑ u yen woodɑ ye wɛ̃. Mɑɑdose turowɑ u yinɑ u nùn kpunɑ.
Yerɑ sinɑ bokon sɔm kowo be bɑ tie bɑ rɑ nùn bikie bu nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ ku rɑ kɑ sinɑ bokon woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑterewɑ bɑ rɑ nùn bikie mɛsum. Adɑmɑ Mɑɑdose u ku rɑ bu wisi. U rɑ ɡesi bu wisiwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛ Yuuwɑ. Yerɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ ye Hɑmɑni sɔ̃ɔwɑ bu kɑ wɑ Mɑɑdose ù n ko n mɔ̀ mɛ u n dɔɔ.
Yerɑ Hɑmɑnin tii u wɑ Mɑɑdose u yinɑ u nùn kpunɑ. Mɑ u mɔru bɛsirɑ too.
Mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ Mɑɑdose u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yuu. Yerɑ Hɑmɑni u bwisikɑ win tii sɔɔ u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Mɑɑdose tɔnɑn ɡɔɔ kun turɑ sere u Yuubɑn bweseru kpuro ɡo be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Asuresin tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ.

Asuresin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yirusen suru ɡbiikoo wi bɑ mɔ̀ Nisɑ̃ɑ sɔɔrɑ bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kɔ̃ ni bɑ sokumɔ purimu bu kɑ suru kɑ win tɔ̃ru wɑ tè sɔɔ bɑ koo Yuubɑ ɡo. Mɑ yɑ suru wɔkurɑ yiruse wi bɑ mɔ̀ Adɑri ɡɔsɑ.

Hɑmɑni u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, bweseru ɡɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ tèn tɔmbɑ yɑrinɛ bɑɑmɑ wunɛn tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ, bɑ tii mɛnɛ nɛnɛm, ben komɑrɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛnɛm. Yen biru bɑ ku rɑ wunɛn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ. À n bu deri sɛ̃ɛ, yɑ ǹ nun ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ kuɑmmɛ.
À n wurɑn nɑ, ɑ de bu woodɑ yɑrɑ kpɑ bu yore bu tɔn ben bweseru ɡo. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, kon sii ɡeesun tɔnnu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300) suɑ n wunɛn tem sɔm kowobu wɛ̃ bu doke wunɛ sinɑ bokon ɑrumɑni sɔɔ.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u win tɑɑbu wunɑ u Hɑmɑni Yuubɑn yibɛrɛ wi wɛ̃.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn ɡobi nɛnuɔ ɑdɑmɑ kon nun Yuubɑ deriɑ kpɑ ɑ kɑ bu ko mɛ ɑ kĩ.

Suru ɡbiikoon sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ itɑse sɔɔ, bɑ sinɑ bokon tire yorobu sokusiɑ. Tire yoro be, bɑ tirenu yoruɑ nɡe mɛ Hɑmɑni u ɡeruɑ. Mɑ bɑ nu mɔrisiɑ sinɑ bokon tem wiruɡibun mi kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbun mi kɑ win tem beri berikɑn wiruɡibun mi kɑ bweseru bɑɑteren wiruɡiin mi. Bɑ nu yoruɑwɑ kɑ bɑrum bɑɑmɛre mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ tire ni nɔmɑ doke kɑ sinɑ boko Asuresin yĩsiru kɑ win tɑɑbun yĩreru.

Mɑ bɑ tɔmbu ɡɔrɑ ɡɔrɑ kɑ tire ni, tem mɛn beri berikɑ kpuro sɔɔ bu kɑ Yuubɑ kpuro kpeerɑsiɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru, ɑluwɑɑsibɑ kɑ durɔ tɔkɔnu kɑ bibu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu. Kpɑ bu ben ɑrumɑni kpuro kɑm koosiɑ. Bɑ koo ye kowɑ suru wɔkurɑ yirusen sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ itɑse sɔɔ, suru wi bɑ mɔ̀ Adɑri.
Berɑ mi bɑ tire te wɑ kpuro, bɑ koo ten ɡɑri ɡɑrisiwɑ woodɑ, kpɑ bu de tɔmbu kpuro bɑ n yɛ̃ bɑ n kɑ yen sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ sere tɔ̃ɔ te, tu kɑ tunumɑ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u sɔmɔ be woodɑ wɛ̃ bɑ doonɑ fuuku. Mɑ bɑ woodɑ ye kpɑrɑ Susiɔ, wuu bɔkɔ ɡen mi. Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ wuu ɡen tɔmbu bɑ wɑ̃ɑ biti sɔɔ, sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ sinɑ boko kɑ Hɑmɑni bɑ sɔ̃ bɑ ben tɑm nɔrumɔ.
